ideas.pitch: A graph intelligence platform that aggregates open-source contributions from campus communities across OpenBuild and maps them into a verifiable developer reputation index.
ideas.title: OpenBuild Campus Governance & Contribution Graph
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages graph intelligence to solve developer provenance, matching the technical depth seen in Bito while directly aligning with HackUnion's mission of bridging campus communities and open build journeys.

ideas.pitch: An AI-powered forecasting agent that ingests campus event logs, server metrics, and student hackathon submissions to predict infrastructure bottlenecks and project submission drop-offs using Poisson regression.
ideas.title: Autonomous Campus Incident Forecasting Agent
ideas.why_it_could_win: Adapts rigorous probabilistic modeling and forecasting techniques to a local hackathon context, following the exact statistical rigor that won the Apart Research AI Forecasting Hackathon.

ideas.pitch: A multi-agent student support and debugging platform built specifically for 10-hour hackathons, combining LangGraph and RAG over local project repositories to give real-time architectural guidance.
ideas.title: OpenBuild AI Mentor Multi-Agent Hub
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly targets the core pain point of a rapid 10-hour sprint by keeping builders unblocked, echoing the multi-agent student support architecture that won the GreenNovation Hackathon.

ideas.pitch: An AI-powered intake and trust engine tailored for local university health clinics to streamline student patient acquisition, triage symptom reports, and generate structured care summaries.
ideas.title: Campus Prosthodontic & Wellness Trust Engine
ideas.why_it_could_win: Utilizes rapid AI API integration and domain-specific UI workflows to solve a practical healthcare onboarding problem, mirroring the winning formula of the Elevate X sprint.

ideas.pitch: An autonomous AI agent marketplace where student builders in Hyderabad can post micro-tasks and instantly settle escrow payments via USDC on Base.
ideas.title: OpenBuild Micro-Bounty USDC Escrow Agent
ideas.why_it_could_win: Demonstrates practical crypto-economic utility through autonomous agent coordination and escrow mechanics, mirroring the exact architecture that won the Synthesis Hackathon Locus Track.
